copyonwritearraylist-concept.title: CopyOnWriteArrayList
copyonwritearraylist-concept.summary: CopyOnWriteArrayList publishes a fresh backing array for each mutating operation.
copyonwritearraylist-concept.why: Readers can iterate over stable snapshots without locking the list.
copyonwritearraylist-concept.tips: Use it when reads greatly outnumber writes; frequent writes are expensive.

longadder-concept.title: LongAdder
longadder-concept.summary: LongAdder spreads updates across internal cells and combines them when reading the sum.
longadder-concept.why: It can reduce contention when many threads update one counter.
longadder-concept.tips: Use AtomicLong when an exact value must participate in atomic read-modify-write logic.

collections-binarysearch.title: Binary search a sorted List
collections-binarysearch.summary: Collections.binarySearch locates a key in a list that is already sorted with a compatible ordering.
collections-binarysearch.why: Binary search avoids scanning every element.
collections-binarysearch.tips: Sort with the same natural order or Comparator used by the search.

buffer-underflow-exception.title: Buffer underflow
buffer-underflow-exception.summary: BufferUnderflowException occurs when a relative read needs more elements than remain in the buffer.
buffer-underflow-exception.why: A typed read such as getInt needs enough bytes at the current position.
buffer-underflow-exception.tips: Check remaining() or structure parsing so each read has enough input.

not-yet-connected-exception.title: Channel not yet connected
not-yet-connected-exception.summary: NotYetConnectedException reports I/O attempted on a SocketChannel before a connection exists.
not-yet-connected-exception.why: Reading or writing requires a connected channel.
not-yet-connected-exception.tips: Complete connect or finishConnect before performing I/O.

cyclic-inheritance-error.title: Cyclic inheritance error
cyclic-inheritance-error.summary: Java rejects class or interface inheritance that eventually refers back to itself.
cyclic-inheritance-error.why: A type hierarchy cannot have a type as its own ancestor.
cyclic-inheritance-error.tips: Extract shared behavior or reverse the mistaken dependency instead of creating a cycle.

duplicate-case-label-error.title: Duplicate case label
duplicate-case-label-error.summary: A switch cannot contain two case labels with the same constant value.
duplicate-case-label-error.why: The compiler could not choose a unique branch for that value.
duplicate-case-label-error.tips: Merge duplicate handling or give each case a distinct label.

serial-warning.title: Serialization serial warning
serial-warning.summary: With serial lint enabled, a serializable class can warn when it lacks an explicit serialVersionUID.
serial-warning.why: An explicit identifier makes serialization compatibility intent visible.
serial-warning.tips: Declare serialVersionUID when Java serialization is intentionally supported.

nan-comparison-trap.title: Comparing with NaN using ==
nan-comparison-trap.summary: NaN is unequal to every floating-point value, including itself, so equality comparison cannot detect it.
nan-comparison-trap.why: IEEE 754 defines comparisons involving NaN this way.
nan-comparison-trap.tips: Use Double.isNaN or Float.isNaN to test for NaN.

mutable-list-aliasing-trap.title: Mutable list aliasing
mutable-list-aliasing-trap.summary: Keeping a caller's mutable List reference lets later external changes silently alter an object's state.
mutable-list-aliasing-trap.why: Both references point to the same mutable collection.
mutable-list-aliasing-trap.tips: Use List.copyOf when the object should own an immutable snapshot.
